title: 第18章 这是最好的礼物
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 那声响从远处传来。辰楠朝着声音处走去，也暗暗警惕起来。这荒山野岭的，偶尔有人进山打猎，说不准就会有大型野兽出没。愈发靠近声音传来的地方，他悄悄拨开灌木丛往山里看去。这一看不得了——是一头野猪正在林子里拱土觅食。野猪也发现了他，抬起头，一双小眼睛里闪着凶光。这畜生少说也有一百多斤，浑身的鬃毛根根直立，一看就不是好惹的主。辰楠下意识地后退一步，想要悄悄离开。可野猪已经被动静激怒，低着头就冲了过来！说时迟那时快，辰楠一个侧身躲过野猪的冲击，顺手从空间里取出一把砍柴刀。这是他一早准备好的，就是为了应付这种突发情况。野猪一击不中，更加狂躁，转身再次扑来。辰楠看准时机，在野猪擦身而过的瞬间，柴刀狠狠劈在野猪的一只眼上！“嗷！“野猪发出一声凄厉的惨叫，鲜血顿时喷涌而出。野猪皮糙肉厚，这一刀并没有致命，反而激起了它的凶性。它拼命挣扎，硕大的头颅顶撞在辰楠胸口上，把辰楠顶飞在地上打了几个滚。受伤的野猪疯狂地冲撞着，所过之处灌木尽数被撞断。“嘶，好痛——”辰楠捂着胸口疼得龇牙咧嘴，他灵活地躲在树木背后，时不时给野猪补上一刀。经过灵泉改造的身体异常敏捷，每一次都能在千钧一发之际躲过攻击。可身体还不够强，只能暂避锋芒，他就近爬上了一棵树。“身体很虚啊！”辰楠也无奈，现在的他是真弱，一头野猪都打不赢，还被猪拱了。“嗷——！”野猪又一次用脑袋撞向树干，粗硬的鬃毛扫过地面，带起一阵尘土。辰楠抓着树枝的手早已被磨得发红，树身的震动让他整个人都跟着发颤。再这么耗下去，要么树被撞断，要么他先没力气抓稳摔下去。不能等了！辰楠深吸一口气，目光死死锁定树下的野猪。那畜生正低着头，用鼻子在树根处乱拱，剩下的那只独眼因为疼痛而眯起，完全没注意到树上的动静。这是最好的机会！他双脚在树杈上蹬了蹬，确认落点后，猛地松开抓着树枝的手，身体猛地往下跳！他右手紧攥砍柴刀，手臂绷得笔直，将全身的力气都集中在手腕上，瞄准的正是野猪那只完好的眼睛。“噗嗤——”砍柴刀精准地砍进野猪的另一只眼睛，顺着眼窝狠狠往里劈砍，几乎把整个头骨都穿透。野猪的嚎叫戛然而止，庞大的身躯僵了一下，然后重重地倒在地上，四肢抽搐了几下便没了动静。砍柴刀镶嵌在猪头上，鲜血顺着砍柴刀的缝隙流出来，浸湿了地上的杂草。辰楠松开手，踉跄着往后退了两步，靠在树上大口大口地喘着粗气。胸口的疼更厉害了，每一次呼吸都像在扯着伤口，冷汗顺着额头往下淌，后背的衣服都被浸湿了。他看着地上死透的野猪，心脏还在“砰砰”狂跳——刚才要是慢了一步，死的就是他了。刚才那一下跳杀，几乎用尽了这具身体所有的力气——毕竟原主身体虚弱得很，能完成这么惊险的动作，全靠他以前练出来的本能。辰楠低头看了看自已的手，手上沾着野猪的血，又黏又腥。他走到野猪旁边，踢了踢野猪的身体。“大概一百二三十斤，够吃一阵子了。”辰楠估了估野猪的重量，这肉才是妹妹们最好的礼物。看着地上这头庞然大物，辰楠又是后怕又是欣喜。后怕的是这具身体还是太弱，欣喜的是这头野猪足够一家人吃上好久。他左右看了看，确定四周没人，伸手抓住砍柴刀，然后意念一动，砍柴刀与野猪凭空消失——被他收入空间小世界里。下一刻，辰楠的身影也消失在原地，十几分钟后再次出现。此刻他已经换了一身干净的衣服。胸口上的疼痛在灵泉溪水的滋润下好了许多。收回思绪，看了眼四周，确定没听到其他野兽的动静，才朝着记忆里家的方向走去。山路全是碎石和杂草，走得并不轻松。今天这意外的收获验证了一句话——意外和明天不知哪个先到。本来还想着去哪儿买点肉给妹妹们吃，可这一下子就得到了一头野猪。这特殊年代里，几乎每个人都吃不饱，有钱也未必能买到肉类。60年代露“富”容易招人惦记，人性经不起考验，得小心小心再小心。风吹过树叶，发出“沙沙”的声响，阳光照在身上暖洋洋的。辰楠深吸了口新鲜空气，心里觉得很踏实。在前世他孤身一人，每天都提心吊胆，不知道能不能活过明天。但现在，他有了亲人，有了安稳生活的盼头，就算是在饥荒年代也不怕。顺着山路往下走，脚下的碎石子硌得鞋底生疼，可他心里却热乎乎的。离桃花村越来越近，很快辰楠就看到村口那熟悉的老槐树。还有远处一排排低矮的泥砖瓦房，屋顶上的瓦片东缺一块西少一片，有的地方甚至用茅草盖着，这就是60年代农村最常见的模样。桃花村有三十多户人家挤在山脚下，家家户户的院墙都是用黄泥糊的，矮得一踮脚就能看到院里的动静。这大中午的太阳火辣辣的热，外面几乎看不到一个人行走。辰楠选择一条有树木遮挡的幽静小路，很快走到一个青砖瓦房前停下。他左右瞅了瞅，确定四周连个人影都没有。意念一动——下一秒，一头野猪突然凭空出现在地面上。一百二三十斤的野猪，他可不想扛着，如今这具身体也未必能长时间扛那么重的东西。野猪身上还带着未干的血迹，一把砍柴刀镶嵌在眼窝里，那模样看着又凶又吓人。想了想，野猪旁边凭空出现一个麻包袋，这是老妈准备的东西，里面都是一些吃的和用的。如果他现在不拿出来，等下就不好解释这些东西是怎么来的。这一幕要是被村里人看见，肯定以为是活见鬼。虽然这具身体弱，但力气还是有点的，辰楠一手抓住野猪的腿，一手提起麻包袋就朝着门口处拖去。他用脚推开那木门。
content_en: The sound came from far away.Chen Nan walked towards the sound and secretly became wary.In this barren mountain, if people occasionally go into the mountains to hunt, there is a chance that large beasts will appear.Getting closer to the place where the sound came from, he quietly pushed aside the bushes and looked into the mountains.This is incredible - it's a wild boar looking for food in the forest.The wild boar also spotted him and raised his head, a pair of small eyes flashing fiercely.This beast weighs at least a hundred pounds, and its manes stand straight up, making it look like it is not someone to be trifled with.Chen Nan subconsciously took a step back, wanting to leave quietly.But the wild boar was already irritated by the silence and rushed over with his head lowered!Soon after, Chen Nan turned sideways to avoid the impact of the wild boar and took out a woodcutter from the space.This was what he had prepared early in the morning, just to deal with this unexpected situation.The wild boar missed a hit, became even more frantic, turned around and pounced again.Chen Nan saw the right opportunity, and the moment the wild boar passed by, the hatchet struck one of the wild boar's eyes hard!"Ouch!" The wild boar let out a shrill scream, and blood suddenly spurted out.The wild boar has rough skin and thick flesh. This knife was not fatal, but instead aroused its ferocity.It struggled desperately, and its huge head hit Chen Nan's chest, sending Chen Nan flying to the ground and rolling around.The injured wild boar rushed wildly, breaking all the bushes in its path."Hiss, it hurts -" Chen Nan clutched his chest and grinned in pain. He nimbly hid behind the trees and stabbed the wild boar from time to time.The body transformed by Lingquan is extremely agile and can dodge attacks at the critical moment every time.But his body was not strong enough, so he could only temporarily avoid the sharp attack, so he climbed a nearby tree."My body is very weak!" Chen Nan was helpless. He was so weak now that he couldn't even defeat a wild boar, and he was even beaten by a pig."Ouch——!" The wild boar banged its head against the tree trunk again, its thick mane sweeping across the ground and bringing up a burst of dust.Chen Nan's hand holding the branch had already been rubbed red, and the vibration of the tree made his whole body tremble.If he continues like this, either the tree will be broken, or he won't have the strength to hold on and fall down.Can't wait any longer!Chen Nan took a deep breath and fixed his eyes on the wild boar under the tree.The beast was lowering his head and digging his nose at the root of the tree. His remaining one eye was narrowed in pain, and he didn't notice the movement on the tree at all.This is the best opportunity!He kicked his feet on the tree branch. After confirming the landing point, he suddenly released his grip on the branch and jumped down!He held the woodcutter tightly in his right hand, stretched his arm straight, and concentrated all his strength on his wrist, aiming at the wild boar's intact eye."Pfft--" The woodcutter accurately struck the wild boar's other eye, slashing hard along the eye socket, almost penetrating the entire skull.The wild boar's howling stopped suddenly, its huge body stiffened for a moment, and then fell heavily to the ground. Its limbs twitched a few times and then stopped moving.The woodcutter was embedded in the pig's head, and blood flowed out from the gap in the woodcutter, soaking the weeds on the ground.Chen Nan let go of his hand, staggered back two steps, leaned against the tree and gasped for air.The pain in my chest got worse, and every breath felt like it was pulling at a wound. Cold sweat dripped down my forehead, and the clothes on my back were soaked.He looked at the dead wild boar on the ground, his heart still beating wildly - if he had been a step slower just now, he would have died.The jumpscare just now used up almost all the strength of this body - after all, the original owner was very weak, and the ability to complete such a thrilling action was all due to the instincts he had developed in the past.Chen Nan lowered his head and looked at his hands, which were stained with wild boar blood, sticky and fishy.He walked up to the boar and kicked the boar's body."About 120 to 30 kilograms, enough to last for a while." Chen Nan estimated the weight of the wild boar. This meat is the best gift for the sisters.Looking at this behemoth on the ground, Chen Nan was scared and happy at the same time.I was afraid that my body was still too weak, but I was happy that this wild boar was enough to feed my family for a long time.He looked around to make sure there was no one around, stretched out his hand to grab the woodcutter, and then with a thought, the woodcutter and the wild boar disappeared out of thin air - and were taken into the small world of space by him.The next moment, Chen Nan's figure also disappeared from the place, and appeared again ten minutes later.At this moment he had changed into clean clothes.The pain in my chest felt much better under the nourishment of the Lingquan stream.Withdrawing his thoughts, he looked around to make sure he didn't hear any movement from other beasts, and then walked towards the direction of the home in his memory.The mountain road is full of gravel and weeds, and it is not easy to walk.Today's unexpected gain proves a saying - I don't know which one will come first, accident or tomorrow.I was originally thinking about where to buy some meat for my sisters to eat, but this time I got a wild boar.In this special era, almost everyone does not have enough to eat, and even those with money may not be able to buy meat.In the 1960s, showing one's "richness" easily attracted people's attention. Human nature cannot stand the test, so one must be careful and cautious.The wind blew through the leaves, making a "rustling" sound, and the sun shone warmly on my body.Chen Nan took a deep breath of fresh air and felt very at ease.In his previous life, he was alone and worried every day, not knowing whether he would survive tomorrow.But now that he has relatives and hope for a stable life, he is not afraid even in times of famine.Walking down the mountain road, the gravel under his feet hurt the soles of his shoes, but his heart felt warm.Getting closer and closer to Taohua Village, Chen Nan soon saw the familiar old locust tree at the entrance of the village.There are also rows of low mud-brick houses in the distance. The tiles on the roofs are missing one piece in the east and the other in the west. Some places are even covered with thatch. This is the most common appearance in rural areas in the 1960s.There are more than thirty households in Taohua Village crowded at the foot of the mountain. The courtyard walls of each household are made of yellow mud. They are so short that you can see the movement in the courtyard if you stand on tiptoe.The sun was scorching hot at noon, and there was almost no one walking outside.Chen Nan chose a quiet path covered by trees and quickly came to a stop in front of a blue brick house.He looked around and made sure there was no one around.With a thought - the next second, a wild boar suddenly appeared on the ground out of thin air.He didn't want to carry a wild boar weighing 120 to 30 kilograms, and his current body might not be able to carry such a heavy thing for a long time.The wild boar still had wet blood stains on its body, and a woodcutter was embedded in its eye socket. It looked fierce and scary.After thinking about it, a sack appeared out of thin air next to the wild boar. This was something prepared by my mother. It contained some food and supplies.If he doesn't take it out now, it will be difficult to explain where these things came from later.If this scene was seen by the villagers, they would definitely think it was a ghost.Although the body was weak, it still had some strength. Chen Nan grabbed the boar's leg with one hand, picked up the sack with the other and dragged it towards the door.He pushed open the wooden door with his foot.
